host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

authenticity.basis: The formal C02 profiler observed 343 bitsandbytes Linear4bit calls per model forward. The frozen 11-request census projects 7,444,815 NF4 calls; 7,441,042 calls (99.9493204332%) are M=1 decode calls in 14 semantic variants.

bottleneck.basis: The frozen OP5 selection probe rotated all 343 real weights in model order and compared the fused bitsandbytes eager path plus a zero-graph-break fullgraph compile path against a same-day 241.755911 GB/s triad ceiling.
bottleneck.compile_regression_guard: The compile wrapper is 3.701x slower than eager by invocation-weighted p50; K2 performance claims must therefore compare against the faster vendor eager baseline, never compile alone.

capability.basis: All 343 C02 modules passed the same row-major nested-NF4 invariants: uint8 packed weights, blocksize 64, uint8 first-level scale indices, float32 second-level scale table with blocksize 256, BF16 activation/output, and no bias. Triton 3.7.1 on sm_89 can express the decode and reduction without a full BF16 weight materialization.

deliverability.basis: A torch.library op can consume the existing weight and QuantState tensors. A reversible Linear4bit dispatch can select it only for the frozen M=1 contract and preserve original parameters, state_dict keys, prefill behavior, and a mandatory fallback.
deliverability.formal_reconnection_deferred_to: OP5 K2 reconnection after isolated correctness and performance

semantics.packed_storage: row-major flattened [N,K], two 4-bit indices per uint8; even flattened element uses the high nibble and odd element uses the low nibble

required_conditions: CUDA device compute capability is sm_89
input is contiguous BF16 with shape [1,1,K] or [1,K]
quant_type is nf4 and QuantState is nested
quant blocksize is 64 and second-level blocksize is 256
packed and scale tensor dtypes/shapes match the frozen layout
candidate_contract.fallback: Any condition miss, including every prefill M>1 call, invokes the original bitsandbytes Linear4bit path unchanged.
forbidden: materializing the full BF16/FP32 weight matrix
crediting repeated-single-weight L2 reuse as formal performance
selecting a manual per-shape configuration after seeing formal results

target_population.formal_selection: all 14 decode rows and all 343 real C02 Linear4bit module weights
target_population.cache_control: Every timing repetition executes all 343 module weights in model registration/execution order before reuse; results aggregate by the 14 variants and by census invocation weight.
target_population.prefill_policy: No candidate timing claim; all prefill rows exercise and verify the original fallback during reconnection.

candidate_design.algorithm: One Triton program owns a tile of output rows, iterates K in fixed chunks, decodes the high/low NF4 nibbles and nested scale in registers, accumulates float32 row reductions, and writes BF16 output once.
candidate_design.tuning_policy: Triton autotune may select only from the frozen search space. Autotune and compilation complete before correctness/performance timing; chosen configs are recorded. No manual shape-specific retuning after formal numbers are visible.

analytic_bytes.formula: input BF16 bytes + packed NF4 bytes + uint8 first-level scale-index bytes + float32 second-level absmax bytes + 256-entry float32 scale codebook + float32 offset + output BF16 bytes
analytic_bytes.cache_assumption: Each tensor is counted once per invocation. No reuse between distinct module weights is credited.
analytic_bytes.tier_b_override: For each representative decode row, ncu dram__bytes.sum supersedes the Tier-A byte count when the absolute difference exceeds 15%.

eager.definition: bitsandbytes 0.50.0 fused bitsandbytes::gemm_4bit CUDA path with the exact C02 packed weight and nested scale tensors
eager.claim_guard: This is the primary/best performance baseline.

compile.definition: torch.compile(fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=false) around the exact tensor-only bitsandbytes::gemm_4bit call
compile.claim_guard: Report it, but never claim success solely by beating it when eager is faster.

reference.definition: bitsandbytes dequantize_4bit followed by an explicit float32 torch linear/dot and final BF16 cast
reference.reason: correctness oracle; full materialization is outside the candidate contract

candidate.definition: Triton fused NF4 high/low nibble decode, nested scale reconstruction, and M=1 row reduction without full weight materialization

baselines.best_baseline_rule: For every case and aggregate classification, best_baseline_us=min(eager_p50_us, compile_p50_us).

actual_weight_coverage: all 343 C02 module weights with unit_normal seed 20260916 against eager
one exact representative from each of 14 variants for every distribution and seed against eager and the float32 reference
assertions: candidate is allclose to the explicit float32 reference cast to BF16
candidate is allclose to the bitsandbytes eager result
shape, dtype, device, contiguity, and finite-value contract matches
input and all packed/scale tensors are unmodified
exhaustive nibble indices 0..15 prove high-nibble-first ordering
nested scale-index boundary cases cover indices 63/64 and 255/256
fallback output is exactly equal to original Linear4bit for M>1 and every rejected condition

measurement_protocol.interleave_order: three-way rotation by full-sequence repetition index; identical 343-module order for each implementation
report: candidate speedup versus eager, compile, and best baseline
analytic bytes, measured GB/s, and Tier-A relative score

consistency: aggregate outcome classification versus best baseline is identical on both days
aggregate candidate speedup versus best baseline differs by no more than 10% relative
mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, and mlp_down_proj speedup direction is identical on both days
both days pass telemetry, memory-clock, and same-day bandwidth gates
cross_day_replication.adjudication: If either consistency condition fails, run one third valid calendar day and report the median valid-day aggregate; do not discard a valid slow day.

formal_isolated_pass_requires: pre-registration hash remains unchanged from process start through receipt write
all frozen source hashes and upstream PASS states verify
all semantic microcases and randomized actual-weight correctness trials pass
all 14 variants and 343 weights complete 200 interleaved full-sequence repetitions
same-day Tier-A ceiling and all per-variant roofline fields are present
no thermal or hardware throttle is observed and memory clock ratio is at least 95%
a second valid calendar-day replication satisfies the frozen consistency rules

aggregate_classification_against_best_ba.positive: candidate weighted speedup >=1.05 and none of the three MLP variants regresses by more than 5%

success_and_kill_criteria.claim_rule: Only the positive class may be described as a K2 speedup. Beating compile while losing to eager is negative, not positive.
kill: unresolved correctness after three implementation-fix iterations: kill and retain every failure receipt
candidate slower than best baseline by more than 30% with Tier-B-confirmed relative score >=0.85: record optimization-negative and stop tuning
isolated implementation plus reconnection exceeds four working days: stop and document
any full-weight materialization or state_dict mutation: immediate design rejection

ncu_tier_b.population: one exact representative module for each of 14 decode variants
ncu_tier_b.counter_permission_precondition: OP4 PASS proves the Windows/WSL2 counter path is available.

reconnection_protocol.registration: torch.library custom op with a fake/meta implementation and an sm_89 CUDA implementation
reconnection_protocol.dispatch: reversible replacement of active C02 Linear4bit forward; candidate only for the exact M=1 contract, original forward otherwise
structural_gates: parameter object identities and state_dict key/value hashes are unchanged
CPU embedding/lm_head storage identities and device placement are unchanged
prefill invokes the original bitsandbytes path
decode candidate invocation count is exactly 343 per generated token
peak VRAM remains below the existing 7.5 GiB carrier budget

tape_replay.decoding: greedy, fixed seed, identical stop rules
tape_replay.order: A/B alternated by request, with both paths completing pass 1 before timed pass 2
tape_replay.hard_correctness_gate: Every greedy token id must match A versus B for every request; any divergence is reported and K2 reconnection is not deployment-equivalent.
report: kernel microseconds and inferred milliseconds per decode token
